seo.meta_description: Full KFC menu with prices and calories for 2026, including chicken buckets, the Famous Bowl, tenders, chicken sandwiches, nuggets, popcorn chicken and sides.

price_disclaimer: Prices and calories are approximate, are provided as a guide only, and may vary by location, portion and current promotions. Last updated October 2026.

hero_image.alt: Pile of crispy golden fried chicken pieces

intro: KFC (Kentucky Fried Chicken) is built around the Colonel's Original Recipe fried chicken, sold by the piece or in buckets, alongside Famous Bowls, chicken sandwiches, tenders and classic Southern sides. The buckets and the Taste of KFC value deals are the best value for a group, while the Famous Bowl is the cheapest full meal on the menu. Below is the full KFC menu with prices and calories for 2026, broken down by category.
quick_answer: A classic chicken sandwich is around $6.99 and the Famous Bowl is about $5.00. An 8 piece chicken meal with sides is around $24.99. KFC runs a rotating Taste of KFC value menu with several items at around $5.00 each, and most US locations do not serve breakfast.
hot_deal: Taste of KFC value menu: several items such as 2 piece drums, 8 piece nuggets or a Famous Bowl are priced around $5.00 each, and KFC often brings back its Fill Up Box deals. The exact lineup changes over time, so check your local restaurant.

faqs.q: What is in the KFC Famous Bowl?
faqs.a: The KFC Famous Bowl layers mashed potatoes, sweet corn, bite-sized crispy chicken and gravy, topped with a three-cheese blend. The classic bowl is around $5.00 (about 740 calories), or about $7.99 as a combo with a side and drink.

faqs.q: How much is a bucket of chicken at KFC?
faqs.a: An 8 piece chicken meal is around $24.99, a 12 piece is about $36.99, and a 16 piece is about $56.99. These come with sides and biscuits. Prices vary by location.
Saucy by KFC is KFC's sauce-forward lineup, built around saucy nuggets and saucy chicken sandwiches in flavors like Nashville Hot and Korean BBQ. An 8 piece of saucy nuggets starts around $5.00.
Yes. KFC Popcorn Chicken is available as an individual portion (around $5.49, about 230 calories), a large (about $7.99, around 490 calories), or as a combo near $8.99.
KFC runs a rotating Taste of KFC value menu where several items, such as 2 piece drums, 8 piece nuggets, or a Famous Bowl, are priced at around $5.00 each. The exact lineup changes over time.
Most KFC locations in the United States do not serve a breakfast menu. Breakfast is more common at KFC locations in other countries, so check your local restaurant.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest item at KFC?
faqs.a: The Chicken Little sandwich is one of the cheapest items at around $2.49, along with a single biscuit at about $1.79. The Taste of KFC $5 deals are the best value for a full snack.
